flags.message: context.distribution_count is 2, but the docket shows no true relist: the Apr 15 2026 distribution (Conference of 5/1/2026) was superseded by the Apr 24 'Response Requested' order, and the Jul 15 2026 distribution (Conference of 9/28/2026) is the first at which the petition will actually be considered. The elevated band therefore rides on a reschedule-before-first-consideration count (the ceiling caveat the statpack's relist cut already notes) plus the call-for-response signal. I anchored on the band as instructed and stated relist-increment from the 2-distribution state.

Material post-BIO development not in the provisioned documents: petitioner's Sep 2 2026 reply/supplemental brief relies on Kelly v. Altria Client Services (4th Cir. Aug 10 2026, published), which holds a plan administrative-services agreement disclosable under 29 U.S.C. 1024(b)(4). I retrieved the reply from the supremecourt.gov docket URL (forward mode) and verified Kelly's text via the CourtListener MCP server. Consider provisioning reply briefs alongside the petition and BIO; they routinely carry the latest split developments.
